caption:
🔥 बॉलीवुड की इस बड़ी फिल्म ने तेलुगु बॉक्स ऑफिस पर रच दिया इतिहास! 😎

रामायण फिल्म ने War 2 को पीछे छोड़ते हुए तेलुगु भाषा में सबसे ज्यादा कमाई करने वाली बॉलीवुड फिल्म का खिताब अपने नाम कर लिया है 🎬

इस फिल्म के तेलुगु वर्जन ने अपने आठ दिनों के पहले हफ्ते में अड़तीस दशमलव शून्य पांच करोड़ रुपये की सॉलिड कमाई की थी 💰

इसके बाद दूसरे हफ्ते में सोलह दशमलव बानवे नहीं बल्कि सोलह दशमलव पैंतीस करोड़ रुपये और बटोरे 📈

तीसरे हफ्ते के शुरुआती दिनों में यानी शुक्रवार से सोमवार के बीच फिल्म ने ढाई करोड़ रुपये का कलेक्शन और जोड़ लिया 🎟️

रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक रामायण के तेलुगु वर्जन की कुल नेट कमाई छप्पन दशमलव नौ करोड़ रुपये हो चुकी है, जो कि सैंसठ दशमलव चौदह करोड़ रुपये ग्रॉस है ✨

इस तरह इसने War 2 के छप्पन दशमलव सात चार करोड़ रुपये के लाइफटाइम नेट कलेक्शन को पीछे छोड़ दिया है 🏆

क्या आपने अभी तक सिनेमाघरों में यह फिल्म देखी या नहीं? 🍿

ctx.title: Ramayana Box Office: Beats War 2 To Become Bollywood’s Highest-Grossing Film In Telugu!
ctx.summary:
Ramayana has achieved another exciting feat at the Indian box office by scoring a half-century in Telugu net collections. 
 The post  Ramayana Box Office: Beats War 2 To Become Bollywood’s Highest-Grossing Film In Telugu!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Ramayana has officially taken over as the highest-grossing Bollywood film in the Telugu language at the Indian box office. The magnum opus has now pushed past Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR’s War 2 to sit at the number one position among Hindi films dubbed in Telugu, and with the film still in theatres, this number has room to climb further. Keep reading for a detailed report!
Ramayana’s Telugu version opened to a solid 38.05 crore in its 8-day extended opening week, giving the film a strong foundation in the Telugu belt right from the start. The momentum held up well into the second week, where it collected another 16.35 crore . The daily numbers from the third week show a film that has settled into a steady post-second-weekend pattern rather than a sharp decline. Between the third Friday and Monday, it has added another 2.5 crore .
Overall, Ramayana (Telugu) has earned 56.9 crore net at the Indian box office, which equals 67.14 crore gross.
With this latest tally, Ramayana has edged past War 2’s lifetime Telugu net haul of 56.74 crore , making it the new number one entry on the list of Bollywood’s top grossers in Telugu. It’ll be interesting to see how far it goes.
Take a look at Bollywood’s top grossers in Telugu (net):
It’s worth noting that Ramayana reached this milestone in a comparatively short span, needing under three weeks to surpass a tally that took War 2 its entire theatrical run to assemble. The film had already gone past Mahavatar Narsimha a few days earlier, and this latest leap confirms it as a genuine crossover success story in the Telugu market.
